_about: Hand-placed heart of Plot 01: the trees, saplings, gap and puddle of the original 28 m prototype scene, now the canopy gap at the centre of the 40 m Stage A map (src/data/map.json). The prototype's three spruces were removed: spruce now grows in the plantation east of the wall (src/world/layout.js). 'size' is the prototype's extent, kept for reference.

trees._note: beetle-killed spruce by the wren's root plate; its broken top is the robin's song post
alder over the salamander backwater, roots arching into the pool
